browser.profile: Disposable Slice Review; no reset/response replacement

gitDiffCheckCommand: git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check (recognizes normal Windows CRLF only; no persistent setting change)

securityReview.limitations: Focused high-confidence pattern and file review, not a comprehensive secret/security audit. Existing legacy development answer keys remain inspectable.

initialFailures: New module SSR assertion failed on existing client-only store; pure status component extracted and test passed. Initial failure log retained.
Initial TypeScript redirection did not execute; successful reruns recorded.
Restricted default loopback socket denied by environment; explicitly permitted read-only request passed.
unverified: Screen-reader audit, real OS forced-colors/reduced-motion, 200% text zoom
Full Exam browser completion and microphone hardware
Diagnostic V1 validity and all 15 metric acceptance
manifestPolicy: Change CSV contains every changed/added file except itself. Its integrity is covered by Git. Later Git checkpoint is recorded in a separate documentation commit.
